DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Hepatitis B infection with superimposed acute Hepatitis A infection.

The test results confirm elevated liver enzymes (ALT 798, AST 488), hyperbilirubinemia (Total 3.6), and a positive Hepatitis B Surface Antigen, indicating an active Hepatitis B infection. The presence of Hepatitis A IgG antibodies suggests a past infection or vaccination, while the acute clinical picture strongly points to a co-infection or reactivation driving your current symptoms.
